title: Choose a new password
intro: Before you continue, set a password only you know. Your temporary password stops working once you do.
introWeak: Your password is too easy to guess. Please choose a stronger one to keep your account safe.
currentHint: The temporary password HR gave you, or your old password
rules: 10 or more characters, mixing letters with numbers or symbols — or a phrase of 16+ characters. Don't use your name or email.
mismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
